reels.title: SlimWise: Decoupling Expert Pruning Across Prefill and Decode for Efficient MoE Serving

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses the core bottleneck of MoE model efficiency. It is perfect for 3b1b-style visualization where we can show 'expert-weight traffic' as clogged pipes vs. streamlined pipelines, hitting the high-performing 'hardware_efficiency' category.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why do massive AI models get smarter but slower as they grow?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A restaurant kitchen where only two chefs are allowed to use the massive pantry at once, versus a system that pre-orders ingredients for specific stations.
